run_save_action_space: run the script to sample and save action space data for all main action mapper tiers
run_save_action_space_custom: run the script with a custom number of actions via the --num-actions argument
review_main: review the main function that samples actions using random state and saves them as joblib files
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional action mapper tiers beyond MAIN_ACTION_MAPPERS
summarize_main: summarize the main function that iterates over action mappers, samples actions, and dumps them to disk
